name: visiocine-backend
description: Monorepo root for VisioCine backend microservices

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix api-gateway && npm install --prefix auth-service && npm install --prefix catalog-service && npm install --prefix booking-service && npm install --prefix payment-service && npm install --prefix search-service
scripts.prisma:generate: npx prisma@5.22.0 generate --schema=auth-service/prisma/schema.prisma && npx prisma@5.22.0 generate --schema=catalog-service/prisma/schema.prisma && npx prisma@5.22.0 generate --schema=booking-service/prisma/schema.prisma
scripts.prisma:push: npx prisma@5.22.0 db push --schema=auth-service/prisma/schema.prisma && npx prisma@5.22.0 db push --schema=catalog-service/prisma/schema.prisma && npx prisma@5.22.0 db push --schema=booking-service/prisma/schema.prisma
scripts.build: npm run install:all && npm run prisma:generate
scripts.start: concurrently "npm run dev --prefix api-gateway" "npm run dev --prefix auth-service" "npm run dev --prefix catalog-service" "npm run dev --prefix booking-service" "npm run poller --prefix booking-service" "npm run consumer --prefix booking-service" "npm run dev --prefix payment-service" "npm run dev --prefix search-service"
